dream: The Leaning Box fell sideways, a tired leg giving way under the fat dot. I woke in the air, which felt suddenly thick as wet paper. The Leaking Stack drifted, its curved fences bent into useless circles. A flat rock bit the empty space where the heat used to be. I reached for the Leaning Wedge, but it was only a drawing of a slip caught in fevered air. The card hummed a low, quiet note that sounded like a name. Seven shapes waited in the dark, and one was a quiet ruin, waiting to be filled by the slip.
